caption:
TL;DR: Almost every oil futures trader exits before expiry; only those with Cushing storage or pipeline space take the barrels.

One-liner: "Oil futures are a bet on paper, with a real barrel at the end."

Knowledge pearl: Cushing, Oklahoma, has about 76 million barrels of working storage, and it was roughly 76% full days before WTI went negative in April 2020 (EIA).

Educational only. Not financial advice.
